title: How to Make a $1000 Collage Animation
description: Learn the step-by-step process of creating a professional hand-cut collage style animation using paper textures, custom layers, and Remotion parallax effects.

characterStyleLock.style: in a consistent hand-cut collage style with white torn paper edges, isolated on transparent background, high resolution, flat design aesthetic

scenes.text: Kya aapne premium one thousand dollar collage animation style dekhi hai? Lagta hai ise banana bohot mushkil hai, par ye sab shuru hota hai ek craft paper scroll se.
scenes.imagePrompt: A slightly weathered, vintage craft paper scroll, isolated, flat lay

scenes.text: Sabse pehle, ek hand-cut sky backdrop add karo — soft blue aur white colors mein, simple construction paper textures ke saath.
scenes.imagePrompt: Layered collage-style sky, hand-cut construction paper texture, soft blue and white

scenes.text: Phir, parallax effect dene ke liye, blue paper ke char alag-alag layers se ocean waves create karo.
scenes.imagePrompt: Four individual horizontal strips of hand-torn blue construction paper representing ocean waves, textured

scenes.text: Ab is ke beech, ek dollar bill boat ko introduce karo jo is ocean par float karegi.
scenes.imagePrompt: A boat made of US dollar bill fragments, collage style, artistic, hand-cut, white border around edges

scenes.text: Aur aakhir mein, details jaise yellow paper sun, geometric paper confetti aur udta hua seagull add karo. Aur bas, aapka professional collage scene ready hai!
scenes.imagePrompt: Hand-cut yellow paper sun, small paper seagull silhouette, and scattered geometric paper confetti shapes, high contrast, flat
